## OfferUtils.validateOfferParams() function

Validates deterministic make-offer parameters without constructing an offer.

Use when an app needs normalized maker input or field-level errors before instantiating an `Offer`<!-- -->. `Offer.create` uses the same validation and then constructs the class instance for grouping and trees.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function validateOfferParams(params: Pick<BuildOfferParams, "buy" | "maker" | "tick" | "tickSpacing" | "maxUnits" | "maxAssets" | "continuousFeeCap" | "start" | "expiry" | "receiverIfMakerIsSeller">): {
        readonly tick: bigint;
        readonly tickSpacing: bigint;
        readonly start: bigint;
        readonly expiry: bigint;
        readonly maxUnits: bigint;
        readonly maxAssets: bigint;
        readonly continuousFeeCap: bigint;
        readonly receiverIfMakerIsSeller: Address;
    };
```

Normalized deterministic offer parameters.

## Exceptions

`InvalidOfferParameterError` when a deterministic offer parameter cannot satisfy protocol rules.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.buy`<!-- -->: Whether the maker buys loan assets.

- `params.maker`<!-- -->: Maker address.

- `params.tick`<!-- -->: Offer tick.

- `params.tickSpacing`<!-- -->: Optional market tick spacing; defaults to `DEFAULT_TICK_SPACING`<!-- -->.

- `params.maxUnits`<!-- -->: Optional unit cap; defaults to zero.

- `params.maxAssets`<!-- -->: Optional buyer or seller asset cap; defaults to zero.

- `params.continuousFeeCap`<!-- -->: Optional maximum market continuous fee accepted by this offer; defaults to zero.

- `params.start`<!-- -->: Optional offer start timestamp; defaults to zero.

- `params.expiry`<!-- -->: Offer expiry timestamp.

- `params.receiverIfMakerIsSeller`<!-- -->: Optional receiver used when maker is seller.

## Example


```ts
import { OfferUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const params = OfferUtils.validateOfferParams({
  buy: true,
  maker: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000009000",
  tick: 5_000n,
  expiry: 3_600n,
  maxUnits: 100n,
});
console.log(params.maxAssets);
```
